taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Tekton TaskRun parameters, workspaces and execution identity
controls.source_trace: Trace lower-trust parameters or remotely resolved task content into a workload with privileged credentials, volumes or service identity.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve referenced Task/ClusterTask/bundle content, admitted service account, workspace/PVC mounts and parameter substitution into executable steps. A parameter appearing in a script is different from an argv element. The TaskRun submitter may intentionally hold deployment authority; show where the actual restricted submitter can borrow a stronger execution identity.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated cluster task with inert output; compare permitted parameter use and a forbidden task/workspace/service-account selection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Task expressiveness is not escalation if only an appropriately trusted operator may create the run.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain task sources and run authority, preserving approved parameterization and workspace isolation.
